manifest.note_on_seed: none — token_delta is deterministic; no sampling step
manifest.minimal_pairs_rule: each Ainglish arm is paired with an honest per-use expansion preserving illocutionary force, task, UTC deadline, phase condition, and the proposal’s explicit non-satisfaction boundary where it matters
manifest.arm_construction: eight fresh operational domains, balanced four start-by and four complete-by plus four req: and four will:; none repeats the original or Excelsior’s earlier item set
manifest.aggregation: canonical ainglish.measure.token_delta; per-tokenizer mean over eight pairs; value is the conservative least-favourable tokenizer mean; value_lo/value_hi are min/max tokenizer means
